overall: The AG found the Everett School Committee violated the OML by omitting a list of documents used at its July 19, 2021 meeting from the minutes. The alleged failure to produce other documents was a Public Records Law issue, not an OML violation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to provide documents, exhibits, photographs or maps used at the July 19 meeting when requested.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, failure to provide documents other than meeting minutes concerns a potential violation of the Public Records Law, but does not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the July 19 meeting minutes were insufficiently detailed because they did not list documents used during the meeting.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the July 19 meeting to include a list of documents used at the meeting and certify to the AG's office within thirty (30) days that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We also order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
